title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I'm to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them or steal past and pick its lock; the captain carries its key. All of it is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, which lies at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea; the order wants it found before the Unbound reach it.
objectives: Open the captain's strongbox in the wreck of the Pale Harvest. (marker: Captain's Strongbox, Drowned Captain, Ysan Jetty)

plan.going: The silver setting named the Pale Harvest, a wreck that may hold the next clue to the Eye. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Travel by boat to Thorn, walk to Ysan's jetty, swim to the wreck and open the captain's strongbox.
plan.ways: Fight the drowned crew and take the captain's key, or sneak past them and pick the strongbox's Adept lock.
terms: Hatandros Bight and Ysan: journal 10: the bay, and the landing with the stone jetty

answers: I am Tarin, a thief of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Nesh-Deeka house. Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight to open the captain strongbox; it is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, a jewel that can heal the trees, at the Root. The Unbound are after it too.
Get into the hold of the Pale Harvest, and open the captain strongbox. Ysan Jetty is the way out/in.
Fight the drowned crew and take the captain key, or sneak past and pick the strongbox lock.
I do not understand the Root, seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel or Umbriel yet; I could ask Nesh-Deeka or find clues in the wreck.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: In the captain's strongbox lay a keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a keystone from the wreck; I do not know what it opens. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by boat back up the rivers.

answers: I killed the drowned sailor and captain, took the key, and found a Kothringi Keystone in the strongbox. It is part of the trail to the Eye of Argonia.
Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go straight to her; I could also keep it or look around the wreck, but the journal says deliver it.
I do not know what Kothringi means here or what the keystone opens; Nesh-Deeka may tell me.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make (the Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu long ago), and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN08 starts; its first entry marks Toklea.
terms: Kothringi: Nesh-Deeka: the silver-skinned people of the marsh, dead of the Knahaten Flu
the Chime-Keepers of Toklea: Nesh-Deeka: the town that keeps Kothringi lore

answers: I delivered the Kothringi keystone to Nesh-Deeka, who was paid me 100 gold. The Kothringi were a silver-skinned marsh people killed by the Knahaten Flu. The keystone is a step toward the Eye of Argonia at the Root. The Unbound have not found the wreck.
Quest is complete; the next lead is the Chime-Keepers of Toklea in the Tulmek Washes, whose elder may read the keystone.
Go to Toklea, ask Nesh-Deeka more (Chime-Keepers topic), or ask about the Unbound and how she knows things.
Still unknown: seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, and how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound do ("we listen"). I could ask her or the Chime-Keepers.
